name: BTM Resources Berhad
overview: BTM Resources Berhad 于2026年2月完成工厂建筑及PME（厂房与设备）的出售，相关买卖协议已于2026年2月11日成为无条件并完成交割。公司其余业务线（伐木、锯木、木材贸易、木材成型及窑干）在所提供的公告中未见新的业务动态。
overview_en: BTM Resources Berhad completed the disposal of its factory building and PME (plant and machinery/equipment) in February 2026, with the sale and purchase agreement becoming unconditional and completion occurring on 11 February 2026. No new business developments were announced for the remaining business lines (logging, sawmilling, timber trading, timber molding and kiln-drying) in the provided announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年2月完成工厂建筑及PME出售，相关买卖协议已成为无条件并交割。
segments.note_en: The company completed the disposal of its factory building and PME in February 2026, with the sale and purchase agreement becoming unconditional and completed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 工厂建筑出售及PME出售的买卖协议于2026年2月11日成为无条件，并于同日完成交割。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement for the factory building disposal and PME disposal became unconditional and was completed on 11 February 2026.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE: (I) PROPOSED FACTORY BUILDING DISPOSAL; (II) PROPOSED PME DISPOSAL; (III) PROPOSED VARIATION; A
actions.text_en: Circular to shareholders in relation to the proposed factory building disposal, proposed PME disposal, proposed variation and proposed share capital reduction.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司完成工厂建筑及PME出售，相关资产已剥离。
model_changes.text_en: The company completed the disposal of its factory building and PME, divesting the related assets.
